input: The A1 parts (segments) and A2 parts (covers) of a story on the program axis with their source IN/OUT, channel, level and off; the 100 ms loudness segments measured with each clip wave; the story rate.
output: The gated integrated loudness (LUFS) and true peak (dBTP) of A1 and of A2 of the program, and whether every part that sounds was measured.
specification: User 2026-10-24: the loudness of the story, normalised in the preview to the project targets (EBU R 128). Composed from what was measured; it reads, plays and writes nothing.
